question_summary: Submitter asks whether the occupancy separation rating stated in Project Manual Section 01 00 00 complies with the adopted code edition referenced in Section 26 05 00, suggesting the discrepancy may be a matter of design intent rather than a strict code violation.
routing_rationale: Occupancy separation ratings are a life-safety and code-compliance matter that falls under the Architect of Record's responsibility to confirm design intent against the adopted building code.
